factualPosition.internationalRetirement: Announced 31 August 2026; official AFA farewell letter confirms national-team exit.
factualPosition.farewellFixture: FIFA report of 15 September 2026 schedules Argentina v Benin at Estadio Monumental for 6 October 2026. It has not occurred at the reporting cutoff.
factualPosition.clubFuture: Inter Miami official announcement dated 23 October 2025 extends contract through the end of the 2028 MLS season.
factualPosition.totalRetirement: International retirement must not be described as retirement from all professional football. Contract expiry must not be described as a confirmed final appearance date.

editorialApproach: Fresh tactical interpretation, explicitly identified as interpretation in the lead. No invented interview, byline, private training routine, medical finding, remaining-career forecast, or post-cutoff event.
sourceUse: No direct quotations. Match factual descriptions are brief and each case study remains about 200 words; the main body is original football reasoning rather than a restatement of source articles.
limitations: Farewell date is a scheduled future fixture at the reporting cutoff and must be refreshed after 6 October 2026.
No claim to know Messi’s exact date of retirement from all football.
No current aggregate career totals used, avoiding incompatible data definitions or stale totals.
Cover deliberately null; root may attach an already licensed existing image if desired.
